task.question: What is the name of the French ambassador to the Central African Republic involved in disciplinary proceedings in August 2026?
task.evidence: 13 August – The French Foreign Ministry opens disciplinary proceedings against its ambassador to the Central African Republic, Bruno Foucher, following allegations that he brought around 30 young women to his official residence in Bangui from 2024 to 2026.
